messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] release started: tag `release/1.4.2`, ref `a1b2c3d4`, initiated by alice. Targets: production. Rollout plan: canary -> us -> eu -> apac. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. tracking: #deploy-1774501234

alice: copying notes here — I'll watch canary and US. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/1.4.2 :sparkles:

bob: noted. this contains runtime kernel tweaks + batching heuristics. perf gains expected for long-context requests.

deploy-bot: canary started (subset: srv-canary-1).

deploy-bot: canary finished ✅ — health checks passed, latency within SLO.

alice: ok moving to US. kicking off region rollout.

deploy-bot: us rollout started. targets: us-west, us-east.

carol: monitoring logs/metrics, will flag if error rate >1% for 5m.

deploy-bot: us rollout progress: us-west done, us-east done. us rollout finished ✅

dave: saw a transient spike in tokens/sec but no errors. good to continue. :thumbsup:

alevin (typo name replaced by erin): starting EU now — ping me if anything odd.

deploy-bot: eu rollout started. targets: eu-west, eu-central.

deploy-bot: eu rollout finished ✅ — all healthy.

alice: APAC next. will start, but will watch model loading on smaller instances (APAC has older cards).

deploy-bot: apac rollout started. targets: apac-sg, apac-jp, apac-syd.

deploy-bot: apac-sg: failed to initialize model on gpu-3 — error: `RuntimeError: cuBLAS init failed`

carol: seeing elevated 500s from apac-sg tasks, ~12% error rate. autoscaler didn't replace pods (OOM/driver issue).

dave: looks like driver/kernel mismatch on that host pool. rolling failure to other APAC nodes is risky.

alice: suggest immediate rollback in APAC only to avoid a full-region outage. pin APAC to previous stable tag `v1.4.1` while we investigate.

erin: +1 — we'll open a follow-up to fix runtime GPU driver and a fallback image. I can repro locally on a sim node.

bob: updating release notes to reflect partial rollback: https://internal.redwood/release/1.4.2/notes (apac: rolled back to v1.4.1).

dave: executing region-scoped rollback now.

deploy-bot: apac rollback initiated -> target tag `v1.4.1`.

deploy-bot: apac rollback progress: apac-sg done, apac-jp done, apac-syd done. rollback complete ✅

carol: error rate in APAC returning to baseline. verifying traces for failed pods.

alice: APAC pinned to `v1.4.1` for the rest of the change window. we'll schedule a canary-narrow test after driver fix.

erin: created ticket INF-4287 with repro, driver version, and a small test plan. assigning to eng-infra.

bob: marking the release state as "partial rollout" in the release tracker. Full global rollout paused until infra fix.

deploy-bot: summary: canary ✅, us ✅, eu ✅, apac rolled back -> pinned to v1.4.1. rollback performed at 02:24 UTC.

dave: recommend postmortem item: add region-specific preflight for GPU driver compatibility.

alice: agreed. I'll draft short postmortem and update the rollout playbook.

carol: monitoring 30m for regressions, then close thread. if anything else shows up ping @alice. :eyes:

alice: thanks all. follow-ups: INF-4287 (driver), REL-1.4.2-apac-pin (pin record), PM-214 (postmortem).

deploy-bot: deployment thread closed (temporary: APAC pinned).
